title: After the last feeding
interpretation: Actual native-grid amounts divided by physical voxel volume; chosen fluorescence proportional to retained-field concentration, plus trilinear optical scattering of catalyst plus .25 bound food, after the recorded concentration detection floor, colored by A/B allocation. Native cell positions and physical body radii; body energy/mass selects optical color. Native ID-validated mechanical bonds shown at chosen optical radius .008; periodic minimum-image edges clipped to specimen bounds. Volume interpolation, opacity, color, bond thickness, light and floor are optical choices; Optional cell trails, when included, are piecewise-linear observations of actual sampled positions during the preceding32time units, not persistent deposited matter; exact periodic translation (.75,-.5,0) applies to all fields/bodies/bonds/trails. No additional simulated geometry, selected wavelength, adhesion, or higher simulation resolution is implied. No source fields are modified.
